text:
My fries were cold, the burger was cold and wasn't even assembled well, the patty was halfway on the bun. I can see if it were late at night or busy or understaffed but it was quiet, with at least four staff around 7pm. I don't expect much from fast food but when I'm paying $16 for 2 burgers, fries and a coke I expect it to at least be hot. And ketchup would have been nice considering I specifically asked for it. Worst McDonald's I've been to in a very long time.

*Edit
I have since returned to this McDonald's and have had a much better experience. Maybe that one visit was just an off day or maybe there was a change in management. Whatever the reason, I hate to pigeon hole a place based on 1 visit. I will eat here again as it's close to home, and let you all know how it goes. Upgrading from 1 to 3 stars.

Edit* I ordered a cone which immediately fell apart all over my hands. She grabbed a cup and put it in there and thought that was sufficient. I asked for a new one. She disappeared for a minute anf gave me the same cone in a cup and said it was new. I'm done with this McDonald's. 0 stars
author: Jason Reimer

text:
I ordered two Big Mac “no meat” burgers and one large Coca-Cola, but instead I was given Big Macs with meat. This is completely unacceptable, as I am a pure vegetarian. Unfortunately, I even ate part of the burgers by mistake because I trusted the restaurant and was confident they would prepare my order correctly. This broke my trust completely, and now I will have to check my food every time before eating, which should not be necessary when ordering from a professional restaurant.

When I spoke to the manager, Prabh, he agreed to make the burgers again but refused to provide a refund. He told me I could either have the burgers remade or get a refund, but not both. This is very poor customer service. A refund should have been given along with the correct order as compensation for the serious mistake.

Mistakes can happen, but how they are handled shows how much a business respects its customers. Serving meat to a vegetarian is a very big mistake, and I hope the restaurant takes this seriously and improves its service to ensure this never happens again.
author: Gurpreet Chauhan

text: This is the worst McDonald's in Vancouver. Its the only McDonald's I've ever been to, where the washroom has an Out of Order sign on the door permanently. Napkins and Straws aren't given out.  It is EXTREMELY dirty and the staff are slow and rude. The picture I included was taken at 8 at night when I estimate there was no less than 5 employees milling about aimlessly behind the counter and besides myself and my husband,  2 other customers in the entire restraint.  There is no need for a place that serves food to ever have garbage overflowing all over the place. They blatantly discriminate against the DTES  residents that are forced to eat there if fast food is their only option for hot food. Other than an equally poorly managed Tim Hortons across the street, there are no other reasonably priced places to eat within walking distance. The atmosphere is dirty and hostile.  They employ a security guard and employees that hate their jobs and the people they serve and make no effort to hide it.
author: Ashleigh Cook

text:
Online Ordering Beware!
Hands down the worst order I've ever received from any McDonald's location, *so far*.

I'm not kidding either, do yourself a favor and don't order takeout delivery from this location. Period. The picture I took of my poutine order should already say it all.

If you want further context, read below:

I ordered a poutine from this location through UberEats. There were no issues with the delivery itself. Opening up my poutine box, I discovered one shoddy, thin layer of gravy on a few hardened, bland fries.
If I had to recount, it only had around 10~ individual fries. To make it worse, it arrived at room temperature, despite how I got my order delivered relatively quickly. (McDonald's location is within 1.5 kilometers away from my location.) In the end, I did get my refund from UberEats (thankfully). Sufficient to say I will not be ordering at this location again...
author: L “P3N” B

text: I ordered a meal from here, my order was placed as individual items and not a meal, I was then overcharged for everything, as it wasn't imput as a meal deal, then had to make a separate transaction to actually get the fries I ordered. I get it, it happens, especially with a lot of customers. However, the manager or the person the cashier consulted for help then waved us off, and I wouldn't have left a review if she wasn't outright disrespectful and not only refused to do anything about it, but also refused to give us a bag after we were over charged almost $5 for an $11 meal. No hate to the cashier, he was trying his best. The manager or woman in charge was outright disrespectful and rude for no reason and should not be working in the service industry.

text: Service is average. The store is extremely filthy . If the health inspector came into this McDonald's they would shut it down. I watched a homeless person bleed all over the counter and no one cleaned it up. In this area there are a lot of drug addicts with a  high rate of hepatitis C and HIV so when I witnessed this I was horrified. There are a lot of panhandlers accosting the customers in line up. Its not the staff's fault it's so out of control and the police do nothing. If I was a tourist I would avoid this area!!! Until the City decides to clean up this drug epidemic the local businesses are going to negatively affected. I live in the area and it's getting worse and more dangerous. I would avoid this location!!!
author: C Me

text: Ordered a sausage and egg mcmuffin and a vanilla iced coffee. The sandwich came without egg and the iced coffee without vanilla. Michelle started arguing with me when I came back to ask for a new order, since my iced coffee was decaf and she said that was the reason the ice melted (which still doesn't explain the absence of vanilla syrup). If they couldn't make it decaf, they should've told me from the start. Michelle was very rude and unprofessional and even told me to get out. There was no need to argue with me, she should've just fixed my orders. She even said "the customer isn't always right and you're wrong". Such a terrible experience. She shouldn't be working there with such poor customer service skills.
author: JORGE LUIS ANDRADE MORALES

text: Getting charged for a paper bag at a McDonald’s with no seats, and therefore no “for here” option, is hysterical. Cashier didn’t understand what “well done fries” meant, he offered fresh so I just said sure whatever, and then they weren’t fresh. Didn’t even punch in the special request. and at $15 for a quarter pounder combo with no upsizes, literally go anywhere else. There’s lot of good late night food on this block.

text: I get that they are in a challenging area of town thanks to years of political failure to deal with drugs and other social problems - but this has still got to be the worst outlet ever. Staff always seem to do a decent job, but for goodness sake sort out the actual opening hours.
